question: How satisfied are young people in the Guadalajara metropolitan area with their life?
answer: 54.8% are very satisfied and 36.4% somewhat satisfied (91.2% in total); the mean is 4.44 out of 5.

question: How many young people never use ChatGPT or another AI chatbot?
answer: 40.1% never use an AI chatbot; at the other extreme, 11.0% use one several times a day.

question: What percentage of young people were victims of a crime in the last year?
answer: 10.7% were victims in the last 12 months (9.3% of one crime and 1.4% of more than one); 88.9% were not.

question: What is the most used means of transport among young people?
answer: The bus/Macrobús, at 43.7%; followed by private vehicle at 25.6%.

question: How long do young people spend getting around on a normal day?
answer: 34.1% spend 31 to 60 minutes and 30.4% up to 30 minutes; 26.0% spend more than 90 minutes.

question: Do young people trust the police?
answer: Little: 67.4% have little or no trust (40.2% none, 27.2% little) and only 15.8% have some or a lot; mean 2.10 out of 5.

question: Of the young people who suffered a crime, how many reported it?
answer: 40.4% of victims reported it to the authorities and 59.6% did not.

question: How many young people say their family income is not enough?
answer: For 8.0% it is not enough (7.1% with difficulties and 0.9% with great difficulties); for 48.3% it is enough and they can save.

question: How many young people see themselves buying their own home in the future?
answer: 87.6% do see themselves acquiring their own home; 11.2% do not.

question: What is the most common reason young people have been discriminated against?
answer: Physical appearance (13.1%), followed by beliefs and values (11.0%) and economic or social level (8.4%).

question: In which municipality do young people feel most threatened by crime in their neighborhood?
answer: In El Salto, at 23.7% (small sample, n = 23); followed by Tlaquepaque at 12.1%, and the lowest is Tonalá at 7.0%.

question: Do women suffer more street sexual harassment than men?
answer: Yes: in the last 12 months 31.6% of women were sexually harassed in the street, versus 4.6% of men.

question: Who rates their mental health better, men or women?
answer: Men: mean 3.94 versus 3.71 for women; 26.9% of men rate it very good versus 16.6% of women.

question: Does Zapopan feel safer than Guadalajara?
answer: Yes: in Zapopan 50.4% consider the city somewhat or very safe (mean 3.26) and in Guadalajara 37.8% (mean 3.04).

question: Do young people trust the army or political parties more?
answer: The army: 34.7% have some or a lot of trust in it (mean 2.67), versus 8.4% in political parties (mean 1.83).

question: Are young people in the high stratum more satisfied with their health than those in the low stratum?
answer: Only slightly: mean 4.42 in the high stratum versus 4.33 in the low stratum; very satisfied 57.4% versus 53.3%.

question: How does the percentage of young people who study change as they get older?
answer: It drops: 66.6% of those aged 15 to 19 study, 29.7% of those aged 20 to 24 and 16.1% of those aged 25 to 29.

question: Does full-time work increase with age?
answer: Yes: 28.6% of those aged 15 to 19 work full time, 49.8% of those aged 20 to 24 and 62.6% of those aged 25 to 29.

question: Does the use of AI chatbots drop among older young people?
answer: Yes: those who never use them go from 29.9% (15 to 19) to 40.6% (20 to 24) and 49.9% (25 to 29).

question: How many young people were surveyed and what ages?
answer: 1,207 young people aged 15 to 29 in the Guadalajara Metropolitan Area, in July–August 2026; percentages are weighted with FACTOR.
